item.title: Knowing a Language and Speaking It Are Not the Same
item.description:
This article is part of my “Before Choosing a Career” series on career planning and choosing a profession. All articles in the series: Career

Learning English is no longer something you can afford to skip. Anyone aiming for a career abroad, in particular, absolutely must master English.
